description: This file sets up the entry point for a React web application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, includes CSS styling, imports the main App component, and renders the App inside the DOM element with id 'root' using React's createRoot API.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render React components into a DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React components into the created root.
